resources.name: 5.4.3 - Cleanup Verification
resources.description: Tests to verify that temporary files are cleaned up properly even after errors

resources.name: 5.4.3.1 - Verify cleanup after successful ingest
resources.description:
After successful repository ingestion, temporary directory should be removed

Test procedure:
1. Make ingest request with valid repository
2. Check that response is 200 with analysis results
3. Verify no .tmp-repos directory remains in the filesystem

resources.name: 5.4.3.2 - Verify cleanup after error
resources.description:
After error during repository ingestion, temporary directory should still be removed in finally block

Test procedure:
1. Make ingest request with valid URL but non-existent branch
2. Check that response is 400 (branch not found)
3. Verify no .tmp-repos directory remains in the filesystem

resources.name: 6.6.4 - Validation & Quality Checks
resources.description: Verify that the Faker-guided pipeline produces consistent, well-formatted responses with realistic data patterns

resources.name: 6.6.4.1 - Data Quality Validation Notes
resources.description:
Manual validation checklist for Faker-guided data quality:

After running the Faker-guided tests above, verify:
1. ✓ UUIDs in responses match UUID format (8-4-4-4-12 hex pattern)
2. ✓ Numeric prices are proper decimals (not strings like '19.99')
3. ✓ Timestamps are ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
4. ✓ Boolean values (inStock, hasMore) are true/false not 'true'/'false'
5. ✓ Enum values (status, category) match defined options
6. ✓ Pagination metadata includes page, limit, total, hasMore
7. ✓ Arrays are properly nested (e.g., items array within orders)

Success indicators:
- All generated endpoints follow the Faker sample data patterns
- No mismatched types (numeric as string, boolean as string, etc.)
- Complex nested structures are preserved correctly
- Response structure consistency across all generated endpoints
